candidates.tagline: OPPO put three 200MP cameras on a phone and called the total '600MP'
candidates.story: OPPO's leaked Find X10 Pro Max (Aug 28, 2026) features three separate 200-megapixel cameras — wide, ultrawide, and telephoto — which OPPO is marketing as a '600 MP Hasselblad camera system,' a number reached by simply adding three identical specs together.
candidates.why_funny: Adding three of the same absurd spec to get a bigger absurd spec is phone-design arithmetic at its finest — next year's model will presumably have four 200MP cameras and be called '800MP.'
candidates.alt: Back of the OPPO Find X10 Pro Max showing a wide horizontal camera island spanning the full width of the phone with three large identical 200MP camera circles in a row, plus the Hasselblad branding

candidates.tagline: Vaseline officially renamed itself 'Baseline' because an influencer couldn't pronounce it
candidates.story: In late August 2026, Vaseline's UK Instagram officially 'rebranded' to 'Baseline' and appointed Korean beauty creator Min Day Lee — who mispronounced 'Vaseline' as 'Baseline' throughout a viral 36-million-view video — as 'CEO of Baseline,' with the brand's stated review process being 'approximately one video, watched over 1 million times.'
candidates.why_funny: A century-old brand whose name derives from German and Greek chemistry decided its 'extensive review process' for a global rebrand was watching one influencer make a pronunciation mistake.
candidates.alt: Side-by-side of the classic Vaseline blue-and-white branding next to the 'Baseline' rebrand mockup, showing the familiar design with the name changed to BASELINE
